name: Question 3
problem:
The velocity $v$ at time $t$ of a particle $P$ moving in the $xy$-plane is given by

$$
v=⟨\frac{1}{\sqrt{t+1}},\,-1⟩,\,t\ge 0.
$$

Given that the particle is at the position $(5,2)$ when $t=3,$ calculate the position vector of $P$ at time $t.$

Question 3
?

The velocity v at time t of a particle P moving in the xy-plane is given by v=⟨1t+1,−1⟩,t≥0. Given that the particle is at the position (5,2) when t=3, calculate the position vector of P at time t.

a
r(t)=⟨2t+1+1,11−3t⟩
b
r(t)=⟨t+1+3,5−t⟩
c
r(t)=⟨2t+1+1,5−t⟩
d
r(t)=⟨t+1+3,8−2t⟩
e
r(t)=⟨2t+1−1,8−t⟩
Submit
